Why do you recommend sea freight?

It’s the cheapest of the four modes, at 7.4 to 18.9 RMB per volumetric kilo. Road freight is riskier and rail costs barely less than road: we recommend neither. Air freight is still useful for a small, urgent package.
We compare a package’s actual weight with its volume converted into kilos. The higher of the two is used as the basis for the price. So a light but bulky carton costs more than you might think.
What do you do on a supplier visit?
We go there in person, check that the company and its products match the listing, then negotiate the price in Chinese. You receive a report with photos and video, and our opinion.
Does the “10 suppliers in 3 days” pack include visits?

Yes. In three days, we visit ten suppliers in Guangdong on your behalf, for €1,900, including food, travel and hotel. For each one, you receive photos, video, price, minimum order quantity and lead times. For more than ten suppliers, we draw up a quotation.
What does a guided trip to China include?

A schedule of factory visits and supplier meetings, with us at your side to translate and negotiate, help with your visa and free access to the SourcingPick app. Flights, hotel, meals and travel are at your own expense.

You place your order through us. We receive the goods in Guangzhou, open the cartons and test your products against your criteria. You receive photos, videos and a report before shipment. The price depends on the product and the number of items tested: it is given on quotation.
